sources.finding: Lists outside-case dimensions; links six original teardown photographs. No dimensioned PCB or mounting drawing found.

Rear-facing component side visually inspected in browser. Shaped PCB perimeter, USB at upper right, microSD near lower sides and speaker tab visible; no ruler or coordinate datum. Board label reads G350 MB V2.0 / 20241210.
Front-facing side visually inspected. Flat exposed contacts for D-pad and seven face/menu/start/select buttons; membrane geometry and mounting diameters are not dimensioned.
Links teardown/trigger modification content; no dimensioned mechanical drawing found.
Manufacturer lists 12.8 x 8.1 x 2.2 cm for RG35. Related model is linked from G350 wiki; shared exact internal PCB geometry is not established and is not substituted for G350 measurements.
Photographer's linked public profile inspected. No measured G350 PCB drawing found in inspected content. No message sent.
Accessible first-person teardown article supplies no dimensioned PCB or shell drawing.
